name: Campbeltown
method: tidetimes.org.uk Campbeltown vs its own Millport (UKHO-derived), applied to our gauge-fitted Millport: median time difference, least-squares height fit
note: Height = offset + scale * Millport: Campbeltown's range is ~15% smaller. Portpatrick fits worse (19 of 547 turns over 40 min apart, none from Millport). HW scatters ~6 min. One height map for HW and LW: separate ones fitted under 0.01 m better but don't cross inside the range, so the curve would miss the low water heights. Kayak-grade, not for navigation.
calibrated_from: tidetimes.org.uk Campbeltown vs Millport, 2025-10-01 to 2026-11-25 (every 3 day(s), 547 events) via tools/calibrate-shift.ts
